profilePolicy: A profile is a complete expected multiset of check ID, status, and occurrence count. Missing or extra checks, changed statuses, changed counts, FAILURE, WARNING, or an unlisted INFO fail adjudication.
deferredProfilePolicy: Future scenarios deliberately have null expectedCheckProfile values in scenarios.json. Their complete outcomes are observed, reviewed, and frozen only when the owning implementation phase lands; this file never invents future results.

automaticWireChecks.rationale: This pinned scenario sends raw Host/Origin probes outside the suite's instrumented wire recorder, so it emits no automatic wire-schema check.
